name: Deadline
definition: Specifies the different deadlines available for the different processes related to corporate action processes.

MarketDeadline.name: Market Deadline
MarketDeadline.definition: Date by which the action should have been completed.  This deadline is set by the issuer.

IntermediaryDeadline.name: Intermediary Deadline
IntermediaryDeadline.definition: Date by which the action should have been completed. This deadline is set by an intermediary.

STPDeadline.name: STP Deadline
STPDeadline.definition: Date by which the action should have been completed. This deadline is set by the issuer. (STP or Electronic mode)

RelatedMeeting.name: Related Meeting
RelatedMeeting.definition: Meeting for which deadlines are specified.
